messages:
sam: FYI saw p50/p95 spikes on /v1/route during the canary. UI shows a clear jump but sample_count was tiny (7) for the minute bucket. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/ghi789
ayana: low-sample noise again. Are we still applying the 90s smoothing? That tends to exaggerate single-window outliers.
izzy: telemetry note: if tdigest_samples < 25 we fall back to coarse histogram which quantizes percentiles. With n=7 p95 will effectively be one of the top samples.
sre-lee: can you paste raw samples? I want to confirm whether it's a single outlier or distribution shift.
sam: quick dump:
```nwindow:2026-03-25T02:14Z
endpoint:/v1/route
region:us-east-1
sample_count:7
latencies_ms:[22,24,25,26,28,310,320]
``n
product-ria: users assume percentiles are stable. UX idea: show a small "confidence" chip for percentiles: low/med/high based on sample_count thresholds, and on low show tooltip "percentiles unstable for small samples; click to view raw samples".
ayana: +1. Also propose gating p95 SLO alerts when sample_count < 30 to avoid noise.
izzy: dev note: lazily fetch raw samples on click to avoid payload bloat. We can also display both tdigest p95 and empirical p95 when count<200.
devex-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-1499 "percentile confidence badge + alert gating" assigned to izzy, due 2026-04-02.
sre-lee: For immediate ops: we'll suppress p95 alerts for that canary window and annotate timeline as sampling artifact.
product-ria: I'll add guidance to rollout docs recommending median SLOs for low-volume routes and note regional failovers can temporarily sparsify buckets.
ayana: I'll draft a lightweight metrics CI approximation for small n to show error bounds instead of raw single-value percentiles.
sam: thanks all, sounds like a clear path forward.
